A single-cell layout wrapper preserves its nested data table as structured Markdown

```elixir title="Elixir"
options_value = %HtmlToMarkdown.ConversionOptions{br_in_tables: true, compact_tables: true}
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<table><tr><td><p>Before</p><table><tr><th>ID</th><th>Status</th></tr><tr><td>123</td><td>Done</td></tr></table></td></tr></table>", options_value)
IO.inspect(result.content)
```
